title: ngcc should not crash when scanning a package with "typings" field set to an array value

labels.name: regression
labels.description: Indicates than the issue relates to something that worked in a previous version

body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/compiler-cli ### Is this a regression? Probably not ### Description ng update fails in postinstall running this command: `ngcc --properties es2015 browser module main --first-only --create-ivy-entry-points" ` ## 🔥 Exception or Error
